facts.text: sent in to feed the hostages behind the counter
facts.why: Wikipedia's plot has Sonny asking for pizzas for the hostages. No hero sandwiches are mentioned, so this scene is not confirmed.
facts.fix: for the cops and the crowd packed on the street outside the bank

vibe.verdict: A sharp pizzeria with a clever name and the Wyoming gag, but it leaves out the biggest crowd moment.
missing: Attica! Attica! (Sonny and Moretti outside the bank)
The pizza boy shouting he is a star (pizza delivery)
The bank lights and air conditioning cut off (FBI takes over)
Sonny burning the register in a bin (opening)
The TV anchor interview (Sonny takes over the cameras)
ideas: Swap the 'Free lemon ice' coupon line 'With every large pie' for 'Chant it loud enough and it is on the house', a nod to the Attica crowd.
Swap 'Soda by the bottle' for 'Wyoming root beer', a nod to Sal's getaway dream.
Add a cheeky line to the guest check, 'Tip: I'm a star', for the pizza boy.
Swap the 'Around the corner, the picture house' caption for 'Around the corner, 250 cops and the FBI'.
